Authors: Snehasis Banerjee, Ranjan Dasgupta

MultiUAV-Plat: An LLM-Oriented Platform, Benchmark and Framework for Multi-UAV Collaborative Task Planning Other

multi-UAV LLM agent task planning benchmark collaboration

简要说明：本文提出了MultiUAV-Plat，一个用于评估LLM驱动的多无人机协作任务规划的仿真平台和基准，以及Agent4Drone，一个任务特定的LLM智能体框架，其性能显著优于ReAct基线。

TLDR: This paper introduces MultiUAV-Plat, a simulation platform and benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven multi-UAV collaborative task planning, along with Agent4Drone, a task-specific LLM agent framework that significantly outperforms a ReAct baseline.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a promising interface for high-level robotic task planning, but their use in multi-UAV collaboration remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Existing UAV simulators mainly emphasize dynamics, perception, or low-level control, while existing LLM-agent benchmarks rarely capture aerial-robotics constraints such as partial observability, spatial coverage, UAV assignment, and multi-vehicle coordination. To bridge this gap, we present MultiUAV-Plat, a lightweight, easy-to-use, LLM-agent-oriented simulation platform for multi-UAV collaborative task planning. The platform exposes concise RESTful APIs, agent-facing observations, role-based information access, hidden validation logic, and optional 2D/3D visualization, allowing agents to solve missions through realistic tool interaction rather than privileged simulator access. Built on this platform, the MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark contains 75 mission sessions, 1500 natural-language tasks, and 9396 validation checks across target assignment, area search, and area assignment and patrol scenarios. We further propose Agent4Drone, a task-specific LLM agent framework that structures multi-UAV behavior into memory, observation, task understanding, planning, execution, and verification. In a full paired benchmark comparison, Agent4Drone achieves a 57.9% task pass rate, a 74.6% average task check pass rate, and a 72.0% global check pass rate, substantially outperforming a ReAct baseline at 30.6%, 47.9%, and 43.1%, respectively. Agent4Drone also reduces the total failed task rate from 32.4% to 12.9%. These results demonstrate that MultiUAV-Plat and MultiUAV-Plat Benchmark provide a reproducible foundation for studying LLM-driven multi-UAV autonomy under realistic information and execution constraints.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）为高层级机器人任务规划提供了极具前景的接口，但其在多无人机协作中的应用仍难以系统性地评估。现有无人机模拟器主要侧重动力学、感知或低层级控制，而现有的LLM智能体基准测试鲜少涵盖空中机器人面临的约束，如部分可观测性、空间覆盖范围、无人机分配及多机协同。为填补这一空白，我们提出MultiUAV-Plat——一个轻量级、易用、面向LLM智能体的多无人机协作任务规划仿真平台。该平台提供简洁的RESTful API、面向智能体的观测信息、基于角色的数据访问、隐藏的验证逻辑以及可选的2D/3D可视化，使智能体能够通过逼真的工具交互而非特权访问模拟器来完成任务。基于该平台，MultiUAV-Plat基准测试包含75个任务会话、1500项自然语言任务及9396次验证检查，覆盖目标分配、区域搜索、区域分配与巡逻等场景。我们进一步提出Agent4Drone——一种面向任务的LLM智能体框架，将多无人机行为结构化为记忆、观测、任务理解、规划、执行与验证六大模块。在完整的配对基准对比中，Agent4Drone的任务通过率达到57.9%，平均任务检查通过率74.6%，全局检查通过率72.0%，显著优于ReAct基线（分别为30.6%、47.9%和43.1%）。同时，Agent4Drone将总失败任务率从32.4%降至12.9%。这些结果表明，MultiUAV-Plat与MultiUAV-Plat基准测试为研究LLM驱动下的多无人机自主系统在真实信息与执行约束下的表现提供了可复现的基础。

Authors: Sheng Zhang, Qinglin Li, Yuechao Zang, Xueqin Huang, Yijia Fu, Cheng Zhu

The Quadruped Soft Tail: Compliant Grasping and Swabbing for Contamination Surveys in Harsh Environments Manipulation

soft robotic tail tendon-actuated gripper compliant grasping quadruped robot contamination survey

简要说明：本文提出一种安装在四足机器人上的轻量软体肌腱驱动尾部，结合柔性夹爪，实现对放射性环境中铍污染物的安全擦拭与样本采集，融合了足式运动与软体操作。

TLDR: A soft, compliant tendon-actuated tail with a gripper is mounted on a quadruped robot to enable safe beryllium contamination swabbing and sample collection in radioactive, cluttered environments, combining legged locomotion with soft manipulation.

Abstract: Beryllium contamination surveys in radioactive areas are challenging for robots in environments cluttered with cables and electronics. To address this problem, we have developed a novel quadruped system augmentation: A lightweight, soft, and compliant tendon-actuated robotic tail mounted on a quadruped robot. The tail features a hollow, flexible backbone and a tendon-actuated soft gripper that enables the robot to pick up sampling tissues, swab contaminated surfaces, and release the tissues at designated collection locations for subsequent beryllium analysis. To enable intuitive teleoperation, a closed-form kinematic model and a singularity-robust task-space controller are developed. Experimental results demonstrate that gripper actuation has a negligible effect on robot shape, while common-mode tendon actuation provides an effective mechanism for stiffness modulation and preload control. Furthermore, experimental validation indicates that the proposed kinematic model provides a suitable basis for real-time task-space control. The proposed system combines the agility of legged locomotion with the compliance of soft robotic manipulation, enabling the complete contamination-survey procedure to be performed without human exposure. While motivated by beryllium contamination surveys at CERN, the proposed quadruped soft-tail concept is broadly applicable to legged robots operating in cluttered, confined, or hazardous environments where conventional rigid-link manipulators are undesirable.

摘要（中文）：在放射性区域进行铍污染调查时，面对布满电缆和电子设备的复杂环境，机器人面临巨大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新型四足系统增强装置：一种轻量化、柔性且顺应性高的肌腱驱动式机器人尾部，安装于四足机器人之上。该尾部采用中空柔性脊柱结构，并配备肌腱驱动式软体夹爪，使机器人能够拾取采样拭子、擦拭污染表面，并将拭子释放至指定收集点以供后续铍元素分析。为实现直观的远程操控，我们建立了闭合运动学模型，并开发了面向奇异性鲁棒的任务空间控制器。实验结果表明，夹爪驱动对机器人形态的影响可忽略不计，而共模肌腱驱动则为刚度调节与预紧力控制提供了有效机制。此外，实验验证表明，所提出的运动学模型为实时任务空间控制提供了良好的基础。该系统将足式运动的敏捷性与软体操控的柔顺性相结合，使得整个污染调查流程可在无人员暴露的情况下完成。尽管本研究源于欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）的铍污染调查需求，但所提出的四足软尾概念可广泛适用于在杂乱、受限或危险环境中运行的足式机器人——这些场景中传统刚性机械臂往往难以适用。

Authors: Harald Minde Hansen, Nandita Gallacher, Kristin Y. Pettersen, Jan Tommy Gravdahl, Mario di Castro

Sampling-Based Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning Other

multi-robot reinforcement learning Pareto-optimal coordination Crazyflie drones sampling-based variants

简要说明：本文提出了CIMORL，一种结合分布式权重预测、特权专家训练和基于抽样的变体的多机器人强化学习框架，旨在在竞争目标下实现帕累托最优协调，并在Crazyflie无人机实验中验证了其鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces CIMORL, a multi-robot reinforcement learning framework that combines a distributed weight prediction mechanism, privileged expert training, and sampling-based variants to achieve Pareto-optimal coordination under competing objectives, validated with Crazyflie drone experiments.

Abstract: Multi-robot systems must simultaneously optimize competing objectives while maintaining coordinated behavior. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches often rely on fixed or centralized coordination, which limits adaptability and violates distributed constraints. This work introduces the Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (CIMORL) framework, integrating a distributed weight prediction mechanism, a privileged expert training strategy, and theoretical guarantees for Pareto-optimal solutions. We present the base CIMORL method alongside two sampling-based variants, CIMORL-TS (Tree Search) and CIMORL-MPPI (MPPI), which leverage privileged global information during training to enable fully decentralized deployment. Experimental validation in cooperative and adversarial scenarios demonstrates a $21.2\%$ hypervolume improvement and superior policy stability compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Real-world experiments with Crazyflie drones further validate the framework's robustness in resource allocation and multi-attacker multi-defend scenarios under partial observability.

摘要（中文）：多机器人系统需在保持协同行为的同时，同步优化相互冲突的目标。现有基于多智能体强化学习的方法往往依赖固定或集中式协调机制，这限制了系统的适应性，且违背了分布式约束条件。本研究提出协同感知多目标强化学习（CIMORL）框架，该框架整合了分布式权重预测机制、特权专家训练策略，以及帕累托最优解的理论保证。我们提出了基础CIMORL方法及其两种基于采样的变体——CIMORL-TS（树搜索）与CIMORL-MPPI（MPPI），这两种变体在训练阶段利用特权全局信息，从而实现完全去中心化的部署。在协作与对抗场景中的实验验证表明，相较于现有最优基线方法，本方法实现了21.2%的超体积改进，并展现出更优的策略稳定性。基于Crazyflie无人机的真实场景实验进一步验证了该框架在部分可观测条件下，于资源分配及多攻击者-多防御者场景中的鲁棒性。

Authors: Antonio Marino, Esteban Restrepo, Soon-jo Chung, Paolo Robuffo Giordano, Claudio Pacchierotti

AeroVerse-SatAgent: UAV-Satellite Collaborative Spatial Reasoning Inspired by the Dual Visual Pathway Theory of Cognitive Neuroscience VLN

UAV-Satellite collaboration spatial reasoning BEV coordinate system multi-view consistency 3D reconstruction

简要说明：SatAgent 是一种无人机与卫星协同的空间推理模型，结合几何感知的3D重建和多视图拓扑-语义对齐，在复杂空间推理任务上比现有基础模型提升超过25%。

TLDR: SatAgent is a UAV-Satellite collaborative spatial reasoning model that integrates geometric-aware 3D reconstruction and multi-view topology-semantic alignment, outperforming existing foundation models on complex spatial reasoning tasks by over 25%.

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of aerospace embodied intelligence, enabling Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously understand and reason about complex environments has become increasingly important. However, existing UAV-based spatial reasoning approaches face critical limitations: single-view perception renders them vulnerable to occlusions and perspective distortions, while most VLMs lack explicit geometric modeling, relying on semantic cues and yielding inconsistent reasoning under viewpoint and scale variations. To address these challenges, we propose SatAgent, a UAV-Satellite collaborative spatial reasoning model inspired by the dual-pathway mechanism of the human visual system. By jointly leveraging satellite and UAV perspectives, SatAgent enables robust, accurate reasoning in complex urban environments. We first introduce a Geometric-Aware 3D Reconstruction Encoder that elevates 2D UAV features into explicit 3D spatial representations. Next, we design a multi-view topology-semantic alignment module integrating cross-view features within a unified BEV coordinate system. We further introduce a multi-view consistency loss encouraging viewpoint-invariant representations. Finally, we construct SatAgent-SR130K, the first large-scale UAV-Satellite collaborative multi-view spatial reasoning dataset. Experiments show SatAgent outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose foundation models and specialized spatial reasoning models by 25.91\% and 11.69\%, respectively, across diverse tasks, achieving particularly high accuracy in complex geometric relationship reasoning.

摘要（中文）：随着航空航天具身智能的快速发展，使无人机能够自主理解和推理复杂环境变得日益重要。然而，现有基于无人机的空间推理方法存在关键局限性：单视角感知使其易受遮挡和透视畸变影响，而多数视觉语言模型缺乏显式几何建模，依赖语义线索，在视角和尺度变化下会产生不一致的推理结果。为解决这些挑战，我们提出卫星体——一种受人类视觉系统双通路机制启发的无人机-卫星协同空间推理模型。通过联合利用卫星与无人机视角，卫星体能够在复杂城市环境中实现稳健、准确的推理。我们首先引入几何感知三维重建编码器，将二维无人机特征提升为显式三维空间表征。随后设计多视角拓扑-语义对齐模块，在统一鸟瞰图坐标系中融合跨视角特征。进一步提出多视角一致性损失函数，以鼓励视角不变表征。最后构建卫星体-空间推理13万数据集——首个大规模无人机-卫星协同多视角空间推理数据集。实验表明，卫星体在多样化任务上分别以25.91%和11.69%的绝对优势超越最先进的通用基础模型与专用空间推理模型，尤其在高精度几何关系推理任务中表现卓越。

Authors: Wenyi Zhang, Fanglong Yao, Youzhi Liu, Peng Hu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Chen Gao, Xian Sun, Kun Fu

Knowledge-Driven Dimension Estimation from a Single Image -3D Asset Generation Technology for Digital Twin Construction AutonomousDriving

monocular dimension estimation knowledge-driven 3D asset generation digital twin in-vehicle camera verification

简要说明：本文提出了一种知识驱动的单目图像物体尺度估计方法，通过将物体分解为多个结构元素并融合外部设计知识，生成逼真的3D资产用于数字孪生构建，从而提升自动驾驶车载相机在虚拟环境中的验证精度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven method to estimate the scale of objects (e.g., traffic signs) from a single monocular image by decomposing them into structural components and integrating external design knowledge, then generating 3D assets for digital twin construction to improve in-vehicle camera verification for autonomous driving.

Abstract: In the verification of in-vehicle cameras, simulation technology using virtual spaces has advanced, enabling pre-evaluation of false detections and missed detections in various scenarios. However, discrepancies in the scale of the object being verified between the virtual and real environments can lead to a decrease in camera recognition performance. For traffic signs installed at high altitudes, distance measurement using LiDAR or stereo cameras is difficult, requiring size estimation from monocular images. This paper proposes a method for estimating the scale of an object by decomposing it into multiple structural elements and integrating external knowledge regarding design rules, geometric relationships, and conventional dimensions. Specifically, this method detects each component from a monocular image and estimates the size of each component by considering its structural relationships and dimensional consistency with surrounding elements. Furthermore, it generates a 3D asset of the object by reconstructing the estimated components. This method makes it possible to place 3D assets with a scale approximating the real environment within a digital twin space and is expected to contribute to improving the verification accuracy of in-vehicle cameras for autonomous driving in virtual environments.

摘要（中文）：在车载摄像头的验证过程中，利用虚拟空间的仿真技术已取得进展，能够在多种场景下对误检和漏检进行预评估。然而，虚拟环境与真实环境中所验证目标的尺度差异可能导致摄像头识别性能下降。对于安装在高处的交通标志，使用激光雷达或立体摄像头进行距离测量较为困难，因此需要从单目图像中估计其尺寸。本文提出一种目标尺度估计方法，通过将目标分解为多个结构元素，并融合关于设计规则、几何关系及常规尺寸的外部知识。具体而言，该方法从单目图像中检测每个组件，并通过考虑其结构关系及与周围元素的尺寸一致性来估计各组件的大小。此外，该方法通过重建估计出的组件生成目标的三维资产。这一方法使得在数字孪生空间中放置与真实环境尺度相近的三维资产成为可能，有望提升虚拟环境下自动驾驶车载摄像头的验证精度。
